documentStandard.name: WHO TRS 961 (2011) Annex 14
documentStandard.citation: WHO Technical Report Series No. 961, 2011, Annex 14 — WHO Guidelines for Drafting a Site Master File

fields.label: Manufacturer legal name and official address
fields.helpText: Full legal entity name as licensed, and the registered official address.

fields.label: Site name(s), building name(s), street addresses of production units on site
fields.helpText: Add one row per building or production unit on the site.

fields.label: 24-hour emergency contact — name
fields.helpText: Person or role reachable 24 hours a day for product defects or recalls.

fields.label: 24-hour emergency contact — phone
fields.helpText: Include country code. This number must be staffed or forwarded 24 hours a day.

fields.label: Site identification (GPS coordinates, D-U-N-S number, or other geolocation reference)
fields.helpText: Pick the site location on the map, or enter a D-U-N-S number or other identifier if the site cannot be located on a map. At least one identifier is required.

subClauses.title: Manufacturing authorization, licensed activities, and inspection history

fields.label: Licensing authority does not issue a manufacturing authorization document
fields.helpText: Toggle on only if your licensing authority does not issue a formal manufacturing authorization document, and explain what is issued instead.
fields.toggleLabel: Our licensing authority does not issue this document

fields.label: Manufacturing authorization document
fields.helpText: Upload a copy of the current manufacturing authorization. Not required if the toggle above is on.

fields.label: Description of authorized activities (manufacture / import / export / distribution), including foreign authorizations by dosage form
Type of products currently manufactured on-site
fields.helpText: Selected from the dosage form list maintained in Annex 2.

fields.label: Has this site had a GMP inspection by a regulatory authority in the last 5 years?
fields.helpText: This determines whether the inspection history table below is required.
fields.note: Not a literal URS row; added as an explicit gate so the conditional row below ('Required if inspections occurred') has a testable condition and a correct completion-percentage denominator.

fields.label: GMP inspection history (last 5 years): date, authority, country, outcome
Current GMP certificate
Description of non-pharmaceutical activities on site, if any
QMS description and standards referenced (e.g. WHO GMP, ISO)
Responsibilities for maintaining the quality system, including senior management
Does this site hold any accreditation or certification (other than the GMP certificate above)?
fields.note: Added as an explicit gate; URS marks the row below 'Optional if none held'.

fields.label: Accreditation/certification activities: scope, dates, accrediting body
Qualification (education/experience) of Authorized/Qualified Person(s)
fields.helpText: Linked to Personnel records where available.

fields.label: Batch certification and release procedure description
Role of Authorized Person in quarantine/release and marketing-authorization compliance
Does this site have more than one Authorized/Qualified Person?
fields.note: Added as an explicit gate for the conditional row below.

fields.label: Arrangements between multiple Authorized Persons
Statement on PAT / real-time release / parametric release use

subClauses.title: Supply chain, contractors, and materials integrity

fields.label: Supply chain knowledge and external audit programme summary
Qualification system for contractors, API manufacturers, critical material suppliers
TSE compliance measures
Measures for suspected/identified counterfeit or substandard materials/products
Use of external scientific/analytical/technical assistance
Does this site use contract manufacturers or contract laboratories?
fields.note: Added as an explicit gate; URS states the responsibility-sharing row below is 'Required if contracts exist'.

fields.label: Contract manufacturers/labs: name, address, contact
Supply-chain flowchart
Responsibility-sharing overview: contract giver vs. acceptor
Quality risk management (QRM) methodology used
Scope/focus of QRM (corporate vs. site level), including supply-continuity assessment
Product Quality Review (PQR/APQR) methodology summary
Organization chart: quality management, production, and QC positions including senior management and Authorized Person(s)
Employee headcount — Quality Management
Employee headcount — Production
Employee headcount — Quality Control
Employee headcount — Storage & Distribution
Site size and list of buildings; market destination per building if multi-market production
Manufacturing area plan/description with scale (simple plan, not full engineering drawing)
Production area layouts: room classification, pressure differentials, activity per room
Warehouse/storage layouts, including special areas for toxic/hazardous/sensitizing materials
Specific storage conditions not shown on layouts
HVAC air supply principles
Temperature range
Relative humidity range
Pressure differentials between areas
Air-change rate
Air recirculation percentage
Water system quality grade produced
Water system details
fields.helpText: Additional detail on the water system (e.g. loop configuration, generation method). Required if 'Other' is selected above.

fields.label: Schematic drawing of water system
Other utilities description (steam, compressed air, nitrogen, etc.)
Major production/control laboratory equipment list, critical items flagged
Cleaning and sanitation methods for product-contact surfaces (manual, CIP, automatic)
Description of GMP-critical computerized systems (excluding equipment-specific PLCs)
Documentation system type
Is any documentation archived off-site?
fields.note: Added as an explicit gate; URS marks the off-site archive fields below 'Conditional — only if off-site storage used'.

fields.label: Off-site archive — document types stored
Off-site archive — storage site name and address
Off-site archive — estimated retrieval time
Off-site archive — includes pharmacovigilance data?
Dosage forms manufactured (human and veterinary)
Does this site manufacture Investigational Medicinal Products (IMPs) for clinical trials?
fields.note: Added as an explicit gate for the conditional row below.

fields.label: IMP dosage forms for clinical trials, including differences in areas/personnel from commercial production
Toxic or hazardous substances handled (high pharmacological activity / sensitizing properties)
Products manufactured in dedicated facility or on a campaign basis
PAT application statement and associated computerized systems
General policy for process validation
Policy for reprocessing or reworking
Handling arrangements: starting materials, packaging materials, bulk and finished products (sampling, quarantine, release, storage)
Handling arrangements for rejected materials/products
Description of on-site QC activities: physical, chemical, microbiological, biological testing scope

chapters.title: Distribution, Complaints, Product Defects and Recalls

fields.label: Types/locations of companies receiving shipments (wholesale/manufacturing licence holders; countries/regions)
System to verify customer/recipient legal entitlement to receive medicinal products
System for appropriate environmental conditions during transit (e.g. temperature monitoring/control)
Product distribution and traceability arrangements
Measures to prevent products entering the illegal supply chain
Description of complaint, product-defect, and recall handling system
fields.helpText: Should cross-reference the platform's own Complaints/Recall module.

fields.label: Self-inspection system description: area-selection criteria, practical arrangements, follow-up activities

annexes.title: List of dosage forms manufactured, including INN/common names of APIs used
annexes.note: Standalone list; also drives optionsSource for the linked multiSelect fields at 1.2 and 6.1.

annexes.title: List of contract manufacturers/labs including addresses, contacts, supply-chain flowcharts
Production area layouts: material/personnel flow, process flowcharts per product type
List of major production and laboratory equipment

jurisdictionProfiles.name: Ghana
jurisdictionProfiles.reviewIntervalProvenance: Default from URS FR-SMF-07 ('configurable interval, default 2 years'); not Ghana-FDA-specific — no jurisdiction-specific interval has been confirmed.

supplementaryAppendices.title: Location Plan
supplementaryAppendices.description: Sketch map of plant location using recognizable landmarks and driving/walking directions
supplementaryAppendices.provenance: URS §6: sourced from an unverified secondary reference (a screenshot of another AI assistant's output), not Ghana FDA's own published guidance. Do not enforce as a hard validation blocker (FR-SMF-16).

supplementaryAppendices.title: Floor Plans
supplementaryAppendices.description: Detailed structural layouts of manufacturing areas; for drug facilities, structural P&ID engineering prints for water/HVAC systems (A2/A3 format)
supplementaryAppendices.provenance: URS §6: unverified secondary source; see gh-location-plan provenance note. Large-format CAD/P&ID exports — plan for chunked resumable upload.

supplementaryAppendices.title: Environmental Permit
supplementaryAppendices.description: Verified clearance certificate from the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Ghana
supplementaryAppendices.provenance: URS §6: unverified secondary source; see gh-location-plan provenance note.

supplementaryAppendices.title: Assembly Permit
supplementaryAppendices.description: Architectural engineering permit issued by the local District, Municipal, or Metropolitan Assembly
supplementaryAppendices.provenance: URS §6: unverified secondary source; see gh-location-plan provenance note.
